title: Trace resolves every readiness-bearing invariant to an existing test
statement: Every active invariant with severity constitutional, hard-fail, or gate MUST resolve through law/trace.json to at least one test path that exists, and a trace entry naming a missing test path or an unknown invariant MUST fail validation.
rationale: Article 13 makes trace completeness a deterministic gate input; ADR-SCR-0004 requires a dangling entry to fail rather than degrade silently.

strategy.rationale: A deterministic test corpus under tests/ and packages/*/tests observes this obligation; trace links the tests.
